openai.feedback:
- Category: bug
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/lib/missionActivityFeedResult.ts:39
- Finding: Grouping removes every eligible delivery card but retains only the last one. For example, a feed containing a phase delivery followed by a commit delivery loses the phase statement and its action entirely, because both indices are folded but only the commit survives.
- Suggestion: Preserve other delivery cards as ordinary feed items, or retain all delivery rows in the result card with the commit last.

- Category: regression
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/components/external/mission/RunResultCard.tsx:58
- Finding: Result rows render only `card.text`, while grouping also accepts cards with `textFull`. Those cards lose access to their full statement: the grouped renderer has no expansion control and never renders `textFull`.
- Suggestion: Keep cards with additional `textFull` content outside the group, or provide an expansion control that renders the full text.

- Category: spec
- Severity: medium
- File: client/src/components/external/mission/SubrunnerRow.tsx:44
- Finding: Subrunner status is rendered as plain metadata text, with no status pill. Although the state is readable, this misses the explicit requirement that status always be a text pill.
- Suggestion: Render the running/finished/failed/killed/stopped state in a visible text pill while retaining the type and elapsed-time metadata.

Ship-with-fixes. The main features are implemented, but grouping can discard content and the subrunner status treatment remains incomplete.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise

glm.feedback:
### Findings

- Category: edge-case
  Severity: low
  File: `client/src/external/parsers/handback.ts:50-58` (`body.replace(/^ {2}/gm, "")`)
  Finding: The dedent strips exactly two leading spaces from **every** line of the report, including lines inside fenced code blocks or intentionally indented content. A report containing a code sample loses its indentation and can render with wrong semantics (Python, YAML). It also only handles the 2-space harness indent; a 4-space-indented report keeps stray indentation on half the lines.
  Suggestion: Strip the indent only from lines at the report's base indentation level, or skip dedenting inside fenced code blocks.

- Category: edge-case
  Severity: low
  File: `client/src/lib/missionActivityFeedHandback.ts:12` (`if (!event.text.trim()) return null;`)
  Finding: A hand-back whose report body is empty/whitespace is dropped entirely — no card, no notice. The user gets no signal that a subagent replied at all, and the spec's "not a message from you" guarantee silently disappears for that record.
  Suggestion: Still emit a card with a fallback body (e.g. the notice alone, or "Empty report") rather than returning null.

- Category: edge-case
  Severity: low
  File: `client/src/external/parsers/handback.ts:44-48` (header-only branch)
  Finding: When the message starts with the header phrase but has **no** `<agent-message>` envelope, `body` is everything after the first newline — including the English trailer (`That "other Claude session" is an agent working inside this same session…`) that the spec says must be hidden. The envelope path handles it; the header-only path doesn't.
  Suggestion: Also trim a trailing `That "other Claude session"…` sentence in the header-only path, or exclude text after a blank-line-separated trailer.

- Category: bug
  Severity: low
  File: `client/src/components/external/mission/MissionActivityFeed.tsx:64` (`useAutoScroll(scrollRef, \`${feed.cards.length}:${visible}\`)`)
  Finding: The auto-scroll dependency counts raw cards, but the DOM length is now `items.length` after folding. When a card transitions between evidence-only and narrated between polls (artifact reconciled away), the card count can stay constant while the folded/unfolded render changes row count — the re-pin signal is missed. Cosmetic (scroll position), not correctness of content.
  Suggestion: Include `items.length` (or the result-group membership count) in the dependency string.

- Category: test
  Severity: low
  File: `client/src/components/external/mission/RunResultCard.test.tsx:60-64`
  Finding: The `formatElapsed` tests don't cover the negative-delta or invalid-end-timestamp-returning-null path through `SubrunnerRow.stateMeta` (verb with no duration), nor the `ms < 0` branch — `formatElapsed(undefined, "x")` only covers the missing-start case. A regression that made `stateMeta` throw on `NaN` timestamps would pass the suite.
  Suggestion: Add a SubrunnerRow case with a non-parseable `subrunnerEndedAt` asserting the verb-only meta (e.g. "finished").

Checked and found sound: the parser correctly refuses tool_result-only content (so quoting the fingerprint in a tool output can't reclassify a record); the bloat anti-ratchet is satisfied (session-parser.ts 842 → 775, siblings extracted); the Run-result grouping is render-time only so `deriveActivityFeed` consumers keep their contract; the subrunner-status text-only requirement (never colour alone) is met and tested; no chat composer / chat-* testids are introduced. The E2E drives the real JSONL→parser→reducer→DOM chain and asserts absence of framing text, so it would catch a naive implementation. No security issues: hand-back text flows through the same `MarkdownChunk` renderer as all other transcript markdown, no new sinks.

Overall assessment: the change implements all three spec items with strong behavior-level tests; the findings are low-severity edge cases (indentation stripping, empty hand-back, trailer leakage in the header-only shape). Ship-with-fixes at most; the header-only trailer leak is the only one a user is likely to notice.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: approve

contradiction.reason: verdicts agree within one step: glm=approve, openai=revise
